question: What happens to one who does not follow the wheel of sacrifice?
premises: the wheel is set in motion
one who does not follow it lives in vain
one who delights only in senses is full of sin
inference: refusing the sacrificial wheel and delighting only in senses makes life vain and sinful
uncertainties: Kashmirian wording may differ from vulgate
plain_english: One who does not follow this wheel lives in vain, and one who delights only in the senses is full of sin.
